description: Permanently delete a monitor. This action cannot be undone.

monitor_id.description: The unique identifier of the monitor to delete. Required.

name: delete_monitor

outputSchema.description: Result of deleting a monitor. On a missing id the tool returns a not-found shape instead of throwing.

deleted.description: True when the monitor was deleted. Absent on not-found.

error.description: Present and set to 'not_found' when the monitor id does not exist.

summary.description: Confirmation of deletion, or a not-found message.
